posts.zh:
dsh-rollback 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。文件变更回滚：捕获 write/edit 工具调用的改前映像（git blob 或快照），通过面向模型的 rollback_files 工具或 /rollback 命令还原。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8c767f6ec357c41b3125.html
posts.en:
dsh-rollback is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Observational file-mutation rollback for the fs tools: write/edit pre-images are checkpointed as git blobs or snapshots and restored through a model-facing rollback_files tool or a /rollback command.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-8c767f6ec357c41b3125.html
